strings.name: Chris Evert
strings.summary: Evert's baseline control, two-handed backhand and consistency brought 18 major singles titles, including seven at Roland Garros. Her rivalry with Martina Navratilova helped expand interest in women's professional tennis. After retiring in 1989, she worked in junior development and broadcasting. She publicly discussed ovarian-cancer treatment and announced another recurrence in June 2026.
